newsitem.title: USA: Perlmutter interested in Marvel - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Perlmutter interested in Marvel - Barron's.

text.p: Isaac Perlmutter, who owns 35 percent of Toy Biz Inc, has approached bank lenders of Marvel Entertainment Group Inc with an offer to purchase the comic-book company, Barron's said Sunday.
The weekly paper said that Perlmutter has also had talks with Marvel and its bondholders.
No one answered the telephone at the New York offices of either Marvel or Toy Biz, when efforts were made on Sunday to reach the firms for comment on the report.
Toy Biz has said that a significant portion of its revenue is derived from sales of products based on characters owned by Marvel under an agreement with the company.
Marvel filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in December.
